### OVERVIEW
Compact panel for Royal Caribbean and Celebrity offers pages that expands every tile into a sortable table or grouped accordion, adds multi-profile tabs with linking, and surfaces upgrade value locally with zero tracking.

---

### FEATURES
- **Show All Offers** button launches the panel on Royal Caribbean and Celebrity offers pages
- **Multi-profile tabs** plus **Profile Linking** keep dual-account upgrades accurate with a Combined Offers view
- **Advanced Search** filter builder with date ranges, upgrade price predicates, and IN/CONTAINS operators
- **Interior / OV / Balcony / Suite columns** show estimated "You Pay" pricing per category
- **Upgrade Price Search** highlights trade-up cost or minimum delta without leaving the page
- **Back-to-Back Builder** surfaces stacked chains with depth indicators; save chains to Favorites
- **Trade-In Value** and **Favorites** columns keep high-value sailings pinned up top
- **Dark Mode** and **Visible Columns** settings let you tailor the table to your screen
- **Solo Booking** mode uses single-guest taxes & fees for accurate solo pricing
- **Side-by-Side Driving Range** allows same-day connections between nearby ports
- **Itinerary Refresh** icon reloads pricing after any updates
- **Pricing Tooltips** break down "You Pay" estimates inside the itinerary popup
- Accordion drilldowns, trash icons to hide noisy groups, and instant CSV/copy export
- Keyboard shortcuts keep things fast on any screen

---

### WHY INSTALL
- Fan out more offers at once and compare by date, tier, reward, and upgrade delta
- Spot stacked itineraries quickly with depth indicators and combined-profile tabs
- Zero in on the right sailings using Advanced Search, Upgrade Price filters, and Favorites
- Stay productive with keyboard navigation, privacy-first processing, and zero telemetry

---

### HOW TO USE
- Open the Club Royale or Celebrity offers page while signed in
- Click the injected **Show All Offers** button at the top to launch the panel
- Save each profile to its tab, then use the chain icon to link two accounts
- Build Advanced Search predicates with date ranges, price filters, and chip commits
- Sort by clicking headers, group via the yellow icons, and hide cluttered groups with trash
- Switch between Table, Accordion, and Favorites views; click Destination cells for itinerary details
- Export or copy filtered offers, then close the panel with **Close** or the **ESC** key

---

### TIPS
- Refresh if the button or offers are missing, then reopen the panel
- Combine date, tier, and Upgrade Price predicates to target specific trade-ups
- Use Dark Mode or Accordion mode on smaller screens
- Enable Solo Booking in Settings for single-guest pricing accuracy
- Use the Itinerary Refresh icon after page updates to recalculate pricing

---

### PRIVACY
Sends nothing externally — no analytics or telemetry. We cannot see your data.

---

### COMPATIBILITY
- Chrome desktop, Firefox (desktop and Android), and Safari (macOS & iOS)
- Works with current Royal Caribbean and Celebrity offers layouts on desktop or mobile (except Chrome for Android)

---

### TROUBLESHOOTING
- **Button missing:** refresh the page and confirm the extension is enabled
- **Incomplete offers:** refresh, reopen, and rerun "Show All Offers"
- **Layout drift:** check for an updated version and reload after clearing cached assets

---

### SUPPORT
Email admin@comproyale.com (include page URL, screenshot, and browser version). Follow us on Facebook for updates!

---
